<span class="line" data-line="7"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">def</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> sigmoid</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(eta):</span></span>

<span class="line" data-line="10"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">def</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> neg_log_lik</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(w):</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="11"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    y </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> sigmoid(X </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">@</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> w)</span></span>

<span class="line" data-line="19"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># 真实工程写法：BCEWithLogitsLoss 把 sigmoid 和 log 合在一起算，数值更稳</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="20"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">model </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.nn.Linear(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).double()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="21"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">opt </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">lr</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0.5</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="22"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">loss_fn </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()     </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># 默认取平均，也就是 (1/N)·(−ln p)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="23"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> step </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">in</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> range</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">500</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">):</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="24"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    opt.zero_grad()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="25"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    loss </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> loss_fn(model(X[:, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">:]).squeeze(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">), t)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="26"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    loss.backward()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="27"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    opt.step()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="28"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"平均负对数似然:"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">round</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(loss.item(), </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">4</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">))</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="29"></span>
<span class="line" data-line="30"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># 输出：</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="31"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># autograd d(−ln p)/dw : [ -2.       -13.22018  -13.505686]</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="32"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># Σ(y − t)x            : [ -2.       -13.22018  -13.505686]</span></span>
